additions.definition: An appliance designed to cook rice with controlled heating. Basic models and programmed models manage different parts of soaking, cooking and steaming; a rice-cooker label does not imply pressure cooking or every grain setting.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

additions.definition: A deep clay-lined oven used for cooking foods on skewers and breads against the heated inner wall. Commercial examples use different fuels and housings; this identity does not establish installation requirements or equivalence with other regional ovens.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

additions.definition: A hinged pair of plates with a lever for flattening portions of dough. Pressing shapes the tortilla before cooking; the hand press is not itself a heated griddle.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

additions.definition: A bamboo steaming basket with a slatted base, commonly used with a cover and sometimes in tiers. It supports food in steam rather than being the vessel that boils the water.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

additions.definition: A long-handled open wire basket for lifting food from cooking liquid while allowing liquid to drain. Its coarse, open structure serves a different task from fine filtration.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

additions.definition: A conical strainer used to refine stocks, sauces and purees. Fine-mesh versions are documented, but the name alone does not specify one aperture size or make every conical colander equivalent.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

additions.definition: A shaped cutting outline pressed into rolled cookie dough to produce repeated shapes. It cuts the outline rather than merely embossing a pattern on the surface.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

additions.definition: A handled blade for scoring bread dough before baking. It makes controlled surface cuts that guide expansion; a bare replacement razor blade is not the complete tool.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

additions.definition: A slender probe used to inspect the crumb of a cake by insertion and withdrawal. It provides a texture cue rather than a numerical internal-temperature reading.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

additions.definition: A thermometer intended to measure the air temperature inside an oven. It checks the cooking environment, not the temperature inside the food.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

additions.definition: A thermometer with a sensing probe placed in food. The sensing area and response time depend on its design; a probe shape does not mean the whole instrument can remain in an oven.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

additions.definition: A pouring vessel for heating water on a stove or hob. It uses an external heat source rather than an integrated electric heater; whistles and compatible hob types depend on the model.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

additions.definition: A hand tool that compresses garlic cloves through a perforated plate. It crushes and extrudes the garlic rather than making the controlled pieces of knife mincing.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

additions.definition: A small rounded scoop used to cut ball-shaped portions from melon or other suitable flesh. Scoop diameter determines the portion shape; it is not a calibrated measuring spoon.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

additions.definition: A tool for separating an egg yolk from its white. Bowl-mounted designs can hold the separator above a receiving bowl; shell-catching features are model-specific.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

additions.definition: Insert strips of fat into a piece of meat, often with a larding needle. This puts fat within the meat rather than covering its outside with a sheet of fat.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

additions.definition: Cover a piece of meat or other food with thin sheets of fat before cooking. The fat is outside the food; larding instead inserts strips into it.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

additions.definition: Cook food in a closed parcel that retains its moisture, commonly folded from suitable baking parchment. Closing the parcel is part of the method; simply lining a tray with paper is not cooking en papillote.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

additions.definition: Prepare small pieces of meat or seafood with a coating or marinade and an initial cooking step for a silky result in a finished dish such as a stir-fry. Methods vary; egg white, baking soda and deep-frying are not universal requirements.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

additions.definition: Press or pinch pastry edges into a repeated pattern, sometimes also sealing joined edges. A fork can make a crimp; the action is distinct from puncturing the pastry surface to dock it.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

additions.definition: Apply an egg-based liquid to pastry or dough before baking to influence surface colour and shine. This process identity denotes applying the wash, not a fixed recipe for the wash mixture.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

additions.definition: Bake food partway so that baking can be completed later. This is broader than blind-baking an unfilled pastry case and is not simply reheating a fully baked item.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

additions.definition: Remove the small pin bones that can remain in a fish fillet. This is a specific finishing operation after filleting, not a synonym for removing every bone from any animal.
additions.uncertainties: No universal operating limits, substitution guarantees or broader aliases inferred.

improvements.added: A colander receives food and liquid poured into it. A spider strainer instead lifts portions out of the cooking vessel, leaving most liquid in place. These are different ways to drain food, even if either can handle a large pasta shape.
improvements.uncertainties: Editorial synthesis, not operational or safety certification.

improvements.added: Bamboo dim sum sets may combine several baskets and a separate cover. The basket, lid and water-heating vessel are distinct parts of the arrangement; selecting a basket alone does not establish the fit of the complete stack.
improvements.uncertainties: Editorial synthesis, not operational or safety certification.

improvements.added: Baking parchment can form a folded cooking parcel as well as line a tray. In a papillote, the joined edges help retain moisture; laying a loose sheet over food does not reproduce the same enclosure.
improvements.uncertainties: Editorial synthesis, not operational or safety certification.

improvements.added: Twine can hold an external layer of fat against a roast during barding. Its role there is fastening the covering, whereas larding introduces fat into the meat itself. The same string can support different preparations without making them equivalent.
improvements.uncertainties: Editorial synthesis, not operational or safety certification.

improvements.added: The dish supports the pastry through either a partial or a full preliminary bake. Which endpoint is needed depends on whether the filling will be baked later; the vessel alone does not determine that sequence.
improvements.uncertainties: Editorial synthesis, not operational or safety certification.

improvements.added: Applying egg wash changes the finish of the dough surface. The brush distributes the chosen wash, but it does not determine its ingredients: retain the recipe’s wash composition rather than treating every brushing liquid as egg wash.
improvements.uncertainties: Editorial synthesis, not operational or safety certification.

improvements.added: A stovetop kettle requires an external burner or hob; an electric kettle contains its own heating system. A whistling lid describes a signal mechanism, not a shared heating method or proof that the vessels can be exchanged between heat sources.
improvements.uncertainties: Editorial synthesis, not operational or safety certification.

improvements.added: A stem thermometer may sense along a length of probe rather than only at its tip. The displayed number can therefore represent a region of food; follow the instrument’s sensing-area guidance instead of assuming that touching a point measures only that point.
improvements.uncertainties: Editorial synthesis, not operational or safety certification.

improvements.added: In a tandoor, skewers support food within a deep heated chamber. That use needs a length and construction suited to the oven; a short serving pick and a cooking skewer do not become interchangeable because both are pointed rods.
improvements.uncertainties: Editorial synthesis, not operational or safety certification.

improvements.added: Changing the perforated disc changes the texture of what passes through: the documented mill uses different discs for smooth sauces and coarser potato preparations. This is mechanical selection, not merely running the same blade for longer.
improvements.uncertainties: Editorial synthesis, not operational or safety certification.

improvements.added: Par-baking also applies to foods such as bread rolls. Blind-baking describes the absence of the eventual filling, while par-baking describes an incomplete bake; an empty crust may be either partly or fully baked.
improvements.uncertainties: Editorial synthesis, not operational or safety certification.

improvements.added: A cake’s surface colour, spring and interior crumb provide different cues. Inserting a tester inspects a small part of the crumb; read that result with the recipe’s other cues rather than treating one clean probe as a universal endpoint for every baked food.
improvements.uncertainties: Editorial synthesis, not operational or safety certification.

improvements.added: Pin-boning can follow the removal of a fillet. It removes small bones retained within the flesh rather than separating the main slab from the skeleton; the two operations belong to different stages of fish preparation.
improvements.uncertainties: Editorial synthesis, not operational or safety certification.

improvements.added: Fish pin-boning is one narrower deboning task. It can involve extracting individual small bones from an already cut fillet, unlike cutting an intact piece of meat away from a large central bone.
improvements.uncertainties: Editorial synthesis, not operational or safety certification.

improvements.added: A covered bamboo basket is one equipment arrangement for steaming. Its slatted base admits steam while holding the food; the basket is not immersed like the food in a pot of boiling water.
improvements.uncertainties: Editorial synthesis, not operational or safety certification.

improvements.added: A lifting strainer can remove a batch of food while retaining the blanching water in the pot. This differs from draining the whole pot through a colander and can be useful when the recipe calls for successive batches.
improvements.uncertainties: Editorial synthesis, not operational or safety certification.

improvements.added: Velveting can prepare a protein before the final stir-fry. The initial treatment and the later mixing with vegetables or sauce are separate stages; a finished stir-fry need not obtain all of its texture from the final toss in the wok.
improvements.uncertainties: Editorial synthesis, not operational or safety certification.

improvements.added: A velveting marinade may include starch as part of a coating before cooking. This is a particular texture-oriented use of marinating, not a reason to add starch or baking soda to every marinade.
improvements.uncertainties: Editorial synthesis, not operational or safety certification.

improvements.added: Bread scoring creates planned places for a loaf’s surface to open during oven expansion. A bread lame provides a controlled blade for that purpose; scoring the surface does not divide the dough into separate portions.
improvements.uncertainties: Editorial synthesis, not operational or safety certification.

improvements.added: Trussing holds the shape of a bird, whereas tying on a bard holds an external covering of fat. Both can use kitchen twine, but the shared fastening tool does not make barding and trussing the same preparation.
improvements.uncertainties: Editorial synthesis, not operational or safety certification.

deferred.reason: French usage is broader than English drum-sieve usage. Defer a scoped drum-sieve identity pending focused evidence; do not alias every sieve.
Names overlap across markets and mesh/perforation forms. No blanket china-cap alias or fixed aperture asserted.
Probes can measure food or ambient conditions. Use food probe thermometer; do not claim the unqualified term as its alias.
Manufacturer marketing groups related regional ovens. Regional identity equivalence is not established here.
Method boundaries and safety context need further evidence; no timings or preservation claims added.
Potential next equipment identities; no ad hoc generic needle or tweezers alias added.
